strings.ReadyHelp: Choose a save folder, then press Start.
strings.MonitoringHelp: Copy an image to save it automatically.
strings.StoppedHelp: Monitoring is stopped. Images already being read or saved will finish.
strings.FolderHelp: The folder is remembered after Browse or leaving the path field. Save options apply when you press Start. Stop monitoring to change them.
strings.ProfileHelp: New Profile starts with the default rule. Duplicate Profile copies the selected saved profile. Save Preset updates this profile, including its name.
strings.FormulaHelp:
PowerRename-style variables: $YYYY $YY $Y, $MMMM $MMM $MM $M, $DDDD $DDD $DD $D, $hh $h $mm $m $ss $s $fff $ff $f.
Numbering: ${} or ${start=1;padding=4;increment=1}. Numbers restart with each Start; Clear History does not reset them.
Random values: ${rstringalnum=8}, ${rstringalpha=8}, ${rstringdigit=8}, ${ruuidv4}. Use $$ for a literal $.
Dates use capture time. The image extension is added automatically. Existing files are kept; collisions use (2), (3), etc.
strings.EmptyPreviewHelp:
Press Start, then copy an image to the clipboard.
Your latest saved image will appear here.
strings.PreviewEmptyCaption: The preview updates after an image has been saved.
strings.ClearHelp: Clears only the current session's list and preview. Saved files are kept. Monitoring and queued saves continue; the Windows clipboard is unchanged.
strings.EmptyHistory: Saved images and failures from this session will be listed here.
strings.LanguageHelp: Uses Windows language on first launch. Your selection is applied immediately and remembered. Restart the app after adding or editing translation JSON files in the lang folder.
strings.NoProfiles: No profiles. Choose New Profile to create a filename rule.
strings.DeleteProfileQuestion: Delete '{0}'? Saved images will be kept.
strings.PreviewFailed: Image saved, but the preview could not be loaded: {0}
strings.FolderReadFailed: Could not read config.ini. Using the default folder. The configuration was not replaced. {0}
strings.FolderFallback: The save folder cannot be used. Reverted to the default folder. {0}
strings.DefaultFolderFailed: The default folder also cannot be used. Choose another folder before starting. {0}
strings.FolderWriteFailed: Could not save the folder in config.ini. The current selection is available for this session only. {0}
strings.NamingReadFailed: Could not read filename presets from config.ini. Using the default rule. The configuration was not replaced. {0}
strings.NamingWriteFailed: Could not save filename presets in config.ini. Changes are available for this session only. {0}
strings.LanguageReadFailed: Could not read the language preference. Using Windows language. The configuration was not replaced. {0}
strings.LanguageWriteFailed: Could not save the language in config.ini. This selection is available for this session only. {0}
strings.LanguageFolderFailed: Could not read the lang folder. Using bundled English. {0}
strings.UnknownVariable: Unknown variable. Use PowerRename date/time or ${...} variables; use $$ for a literal $.
strings.InvalidWindowsName: The generated name must be a valid Windows filename, at most 255 characters, without path separators or a trailing dot/space.
strings.ReservedName: The formula produces a reserved Windows device name.
strings.RandomLength: Random string length must be between 1 and 255.
strings.CounterOptions: Counter options are start, increment and padding (0–255).
strings.InvalidProfileName: Enter a profile name without control characters.
strings.ProfileNameConflict: Another profile already uses that name. Choose a unique name.
strings.PresetIdMismatch: A filename preset ID does not match its INI entry.
strings.InvalidPresetIdentity: Preset names and IDs must be valid and unique.
strings.MissingPreset: The selected filename preset does not exist.
strings.AbsoluteFolder: Choose an absolute save folder path.
strings.AbsoluteFolderNoBreaks: Choose an absolute save folder path without line breaks.
strings.UsableFolder: Choose a usable save folder before starting monitoring.
strings.WindowsOpenFolderFailed: Windows could not open this folder.
strings.ClipboardTooFast: Clipboard images are arriving too quickly. Copy the image again.
strings.ClipboardTooLarge: The clipboard image exceeds the 128 MB limit.
strings.SavingBusy: Image saving is busy. Copy the image again after a moment.
strings.ImageTooLarge: The image exceeds the 64 megapixel limit.
strings.InvalidQuality: JPEG quality must be between 1 and 100.
strings.ExecutableUnavailable: The application executable location is unavailable.
strings.InvalidIniSection: config.ini contains an invalid section header.
strings.InvalidIniValue: An INI value cannot contain line breaks.
strings.InvalidLanguageTag: Use a language tag as the JSON filename.
strings.LanguageFileTooLarge: Translation files must be at most 1 MB.
strings.InvalidLanguageName: languageName must be a nonempty string.
strings.InvalidTranslationEntry: Translation keys must be unique and values must be nonempty strings.
strings.DuplicateLanguageTag: Another file already defines this language tag.
